{{Top|leg}}
The '''00D-A charged plating shield system''' was a shield system developed by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]] for [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The 00D-A was a strong shield with a good regeneration rate, but approximately half of the damage taken by the shield bled through to the [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] hull. Thus, [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] were able to activate their hull's charged plating to significantly increase damage reduction for a short [[Time/Legends|time]].<ref name="TOR:GS">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Starfighter]]''</ref>
